2 Art. 3. & Onuphrii temeritas nulla ra-tione excufari queat. ] bonos fpongia corrigere non folent in hunc modum boni, quamuis lapfos hu-manitus. fic etiam deinceps.
main_text.head: In Caput II.
main_text.p: 1 Art. 2. aduerfus Illyricum clarifsimè de-monftrabimus. ] de hac re pòft videbitur cap. 3. & feq.

2 Art. 6. à Gregorio v. Pontifice, Othone III. Imperatore confentiente factam esse. ] Dicen-dum diuerso ordine, ab Imperio ipso, id est, Proceri-bus Imperii decretum fuisse factum, & à Pontifice ap-probatum, ac velut religiosa mantissa auctoratum, vt cap. 7. nota 1. diximus.
3 Art. 7. vt soli Principes Regem eligerent.] etsi in his omnibus locis nomen populi pro ipsis proceribus populi (vt fit) commodè poffet accipi. Sed quid ad nos ista?
4 Art. 8. non potuisse eum bona conscientia non mentiri?] bona verba, quæso: Theologos decet sine contumelia sententiam dicere. De re videamus.
5 Ibid. modò Italicos principes numerantes.] Negatur his omnibus probari quicquam eorum quæ negat Illyricus. Negat verum esse quod tradit Onu-

page.notes: Marginal notes on the left edge are largely bleed-through from the facing page and are illegible; not transcribed. Several printed numbers in the margin (I, 2, 3, 4, 5) are side-numbers of article references. The final line is partly cut off at the bottom of the column ("Onu-" continues on the next page). Some words in the italic article lines are uncertain, notably "Onuphrii" and "Othone".
